algorithms.html: When processing a card template, the following steps MUST be performed:

steps.html: Validate the template JSON object against the JSON template schema defined above. If validation fails, processing MUST stop and an error MUST be returned.
For each string value in the template object:

If the string value starts with / (indicating it is a JSON pointer), evaluate it using the JSON Pointer algorithm JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Pointer against the verifiable credential as the target document.

If the JSON pointer evaluation succeeds, replace the JSON pointer string with
                    the resolved value. If the resolved value is not a string, convert it to a
                    string representation.
If the JSON pointer evaluation fails or returns null, the behavior is implementation-specific. Implementations MAY use an empty string, leave the value as null, or signal an error.
If the string value does not start with /, treat it as a literal string and leave it unchanged.
Validate the resulting JSON object against the card output schema. If validation fails, processing MUST stop and an error MUST be returned.

algorithms.html: The host page MUST create an iframe element to host the HTML template. The host page MUST set the sandbox attribute on the iframe to allow-scripts to prevent navigation and top-level access.

steps.html: Let vc be the verifiable credential to be rendered.
Let renderMethod be the chosen renderMethod property in vc where renderMethod.type is TemplateRenderMethod and renderMethod.renderSuite is html.
If renderMethod.template is a string, then let template be the value of renderMethod.template.
If renderMethod.template is a map, then let template be the result of fetching the URL in renderMethod.template.id.

algorithms.html: The host page MUST create the wrapper code by embedding the filtered verifiable credential and the HTML template into the wrapper code template defined above.

steps.html: Let wrapperCode be an HTML Document with <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src data: 'unsafe-inline'"> in the <head>.
Let datablock be an HTML Data Block with a type of application/vc.
Set the contents of datablock to be the filtered verifiable credential in stringified JSON format.
Insert datablock into the <head> of wrapperCode.
Insert the value of template into the <body> of wrapperCode.

algorithms.html: The host page MUST set the srcdoc attribute of the iframe to the resulting wrapper code.

steps.html: Set the srcdoc attribute of the iframe to the stringified HTML of wrapperCode.

algorithms.html: The host page MUST setup a communication channel with the wrapper code to receive ready and error messages as described above.

steps.html: Let renderPromise be a new Promise that:
On resolve, can be used to display the iframe to the user.
On reject, display the error message to the user.
In the onload event of the iframe:
Let channel be a new MessageChannel.
Create and start a new port1 listener on channel that listens for a ready message from the code in template now injected into the iframe via wrapperCode.
In the port1 listener, if a ready message is received, resolve renderPromise. If an error message is received, reject renderPromise with the error message.
Use postMessage to send port2 of channel to the iframe content window.

algorithms.html: The wrapper code MUST setup to receive communication from the host page via the MessageChannel and provide the window.renderMethodReady method for use by the template code.

steps.html: In the window.onload event...
Let port be the MessagePort received from the host page via the message event.
Create window.renderMethodReady function that...
If called with no arguments, sends a ready message to the host page via port.
If called with an Error argument, sends an error message to the host page via port with the error message.
